An Icon, Reinvented: The Coachman VIP 575 Travel Trailer Is Better Than Ever for 2027
28 photos
Photo: Coachman Caravans
"The road to freedom" might be twisted or long or even still a mystery when you set out, but it should include a premium travel trailer from Coachman Caravans. Or so says Coachman in their decades-old mantra and logo, with full applicability for the models in their signature range, the VIP.
With a name like that, you should only expect the best of the best. The VIP series of travel trailers from Coachman is comprised of five floorplans for the 2027 model year, all of them single axle and all of them centered on offering a premium experience onboard.
The VIP series is closing on 40 years of existence, but they're aging like fine wine. It's the signature and flagship series from the esteemed British RV specialist, embodying the Coachman spirit and dedication to a product well made. The VIP travel trailers are one step down from the newer Lusso models we checked out recently, but they're still premium – and absolutely gorgeous as well.
The VIP 575 is the largest of the five entries in the VIP series but still a single-axle model. Coachman has chosen it as a highlight for the updates introduced for 2027, from the new graphics and new diamond-cut alloy wheels to the overhauled interiors, with re-engineered cabinetry, new hardware, new upholstery, and lots of modern tech.
Photo: Coachman Caravans Coming in at 7.43 meters (24.3 feet) of length, the VIP 575 is built on an AL-KO galvanized steel chassis and comes standard with AL-KO stabilizer and shock absorbers. Other features mentioned in the introductory video tour below, like the wheel lock and AL-KO ATC, are available but only as paid upgrades.
The VIP 575 is built with aluminum sandwich construction sidewalls and sandwich roof and floor, double-glazed plastic windows, and the now-iconic Coachman oversized windshield that turns the space up front into an atrium-like space. That last one comes very in handy in the VIP 575, where you get a face-to-face seating area slash dining room slash secondary bedroom.
This floorplan offers sleeping for four people maximum and it's one of the most popular in the entire range. Despite its relative family-friendliness , it's actually preferred as a couple's floorplan, since it features a rear bathroom that has the guests sleeping up front passing through the main, fixed bedroom to reach it. In a midnight emergency, this solution is less than ideal, as you must agree.
Photo: Coachman Caravans Still, you have a double bed at the front, should you ever need it. During the day, it transforms into a nice seating area on dual facing couches, with a small pull-out snack/games table coming out of the piece of furniture at the very front.
The slatted extension that joins the couches into a bed is also tucked in there, while the larger dining table is a movable one that stores in a dedicated cabinet by the door.
New for 2027 in this space is the cabinetry, which has been redesigned with rounded edges, new woods, new finishes, black hardware, and soft-close hinges throughout. The soft-touch upholstery and the selection of pillows are also new, as are the acoustic panels on the walls at the front end in the lounge.
Photo: Coachman Caravans From the lounge to the kitchen is but a step, but Coachman does its best to separate the two areas visually, if not physically. An L-shaped kitchen block with new composite counters for more workspace, a flip-up extension, and a sink insert takes up center stage and delivers real home comforts.
This space comes equipped with a four-burner hybrid cooktop (three burners on gas and one hotplate), a large oven, a separate grill, a new extractor, and a flat-bed microwave. The new backsplash matches the composite counter, while cabinetry has been optimized to offer more storage volume. A Thetford fridge with freezer is tucked under the counter across the way.
The bedroom is located in the center of the trailer , so it's essentially a pass-through one. Coachman does its best to turn a con into an advantage, adding a tilting bed with a large storage compartment underneath (also accessible from the outside), overhead lockers, and matching wardrobes with nightstands on either side.
Photo: Coachman Caravans A "luxurious" headboard adds a touch of sophistication, while under-mounted reading lights and USB outlets add convenience. The mattress is on gas-assisted struts and sits on a slatted, ventilated base.
The bathroom runs the full width of the trailer and it's very much a residential one in functionality. It features a walk-in shower with glass doors on the campside, a raised bowl on a vanity with storage, and a cassette toilet with a ladder-style tower heater. Hardware is black, like in the rest of the trailer, with backsplash that matches the one in the kitchen, and excellent lighting.
The VIP 575 comes with dual lockers at the front , one for a pair of gas bottles and the other for storage, a new door with central locking, a new touchscreen control panel, a Thatchcam-approved Scorpion S7 tracker, and Alde wet central heating that runs under the floor and provides instant hot water. This is a year-round caravan that can further be upgraded by adding options from a list: ATC, secure wheel lock, a 120W Truma flexible solar panel, a Truma AC unit, 4G WiFi, or a chassis upgrade.
Photo: Coachman Caravans Speaking of upgrading the weight, standard configuration brings you a towable tipping the scales at 1,511 kg (3,331 lbs) empty, with 1,667 kg (3,675 lbs) of maximum permissible weight.
Prices for the 2027 Coachman VIP 575 start at £38,430 for 2027, which would be roughly €45,800 or $51,500 at the current exchange rate. Since these trailers are only sold locally within the UK, those numbers are for reference only.
